title: Super Cup ATTP – Spring 2024: OPEN
excerpt: Results of the second stage of SUPER CUP ATTP – Spring 2024
body_html:
The country’s best table tennis players 💪 met in the final OPEN stage of Super Cup ATTP – Spring 2024 🏆 at the TOP CUP Arena. Unfortunately, the stars of home table tennis ⭐️ and world-class masters such as Vladislav Ursu and Andrei Puțuntica could not take part, as they were busy with one of the most important events of their sporting lives — qualification for the Paris 2024 Olympic Games. Even so, the stars’ absence from the TOP CUP Arena did not reduce the scale or the emotion of the battle for the main trophy — the ATTP Super Cup.

As a reminder, from 24 to 26 May 2024 the TOP CUP Arena hosted one of the most prestigious and grandest seasonal table tennis competitions in the Republic of Moldova🇲🇩. Every table tennis amateur in the country dreams of winning this tournament, regardless of age or sporting category.

The explanation is simple — more than 250 participants ‼️ and only one trophy, along with a small number of exclusive prizes that are, without doubt, the most valuable 🎁🏅.

In the men’s group of the OPEN stage, the main intrigue was the clash between Moldova’s best table tennis masters and the leaders of the Setka Cup tournaments: Danila Titov, Veniamin Dubrovin and Denis Țerna.

Could Masters Cup 2024 winner Dubrovin, or Titov, still unbeaten in Setka Cup tournaments, give Denis Țerna real competition and a fight worthy of him? As it turned out, yes!

The intrigue turned into drama as early as the semi-finals, where Veniamin Dubrovin lost to Denis Țerna 1:3, and in the final clash of the titans🦸 Denis Țerna confirmed his supremacy💪, beating Danila Titov 3:1 in an extremely tough battle⚡️🔥.

In the women’s group of the OPEN stage, the trophy and the top step of the podium 🏆🥇 went to Master of Sport Aliona Ni, who confidently beat her rival Cristina Lipcan 3:1 in the final.
